Subject: Clarification regarding upcoming visitor arrangements

Dear [Sender's Name],

I am writing to ensure we provide the best possible experience for our upcoming visitors. The email mentioned that they have dietary preferences and will be staying over, but I would appreciate some additional details to make the necessary arrangements.

Could you please specify what their dietary preferences are? Additionally, are there any other specific requirements or arrangements needed for their stay that I should be aware of?

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
